components.label: api
responsibilities: Publish typed IO operations to other components.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own connectors, source loading, or output writes.

requires.rationale: The compatibility facade exposes connector classes.
The public facade delegates source loading.
The public facade delegates target writing.
Dataset entry points delegate file access.

components.label: contracts
responsibilities: Define IO-owned request/result types and pure pagination primitives.
forbidden_responsibilities: Instantiate clients or execute reads and writes.

components.label: clients
forbidden_responsibilities: Choose source rows or exporter policy.

requires.rationale: Connector methods use IO-owned value types.

components.label: data_sources
responsibilities: Load, page, and select source data.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own runtime tasks or output writes.

requires.rationale: Source loading uses shared IO value types.
File sources use one file implementation.

components.label: exporters
responsibilities: Own target writes, output formats, and exporter lifecycle.
forbidden_responsibilities: Read source rows or execute runtime tasks.

requires.rationale: Exporter entry points use IO-owned types.
File targets use the IO file implementation.

components.label: files
responsibilities: Read file formats and cache reusable file content.
forbidden_responsibilities: Know runtime tasks, clients, or exporters.

rules.rationale: Connector code must not depend on source or exporter policy.
